_doc: Automix ladder (T4.8, FR-PLAY-010, docs/04 §4.3 — copy of Mixxx Skip Silence, Plexamp/MPD/RadioBOSS envelope overlap, VirtualDJ/djay beatmatch). Times in ms. threshold_db: the overlap is where the envelope falls under LUFS − threshold (MPD −17 dB). natural_fade: a tail that drops ≥ drop_db over the last window_ms is mixed under, not faded. sharp_start_ms: B reaching the threshold that fast gets a fade-in. intensity: overlap bounds and the tempo tolerance for beatmatch (0 = no beatmatch). genre_blacklist_words: the words each blacklist key matches in a genre tag (normalised, Russian aliases included).
